title: The Signature Campus Safety Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Emergency contacts, official safety procedures, and published alerts. The Campus Safety Resource Database records emergency contacts, official safety procedures, alert-system signup links, and published safety resources such as escort services and blue-light phone maps. Records carry verification dates because safety information must be current. The Signature side adds scenario plans for common emergencies.

Document official safety procedures by scenario
Map safety resources such as escort services
Provide scenario plans for common emergencies
Carry verification dates on every safety record
